title: Answers
description: Questions, answer times and modes, limits and refused questions, model calls, documents.

list.name: tests
list.label: Sessions
list.query: Students only : false,With teacher tests : true

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.started_at, r.status, r.stop_reason, r.question,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS seconds,
         coalesce(r.mode, m.answer_mode,
                  CASE WHEN r.assistant_message_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'research' END) AS mode,
         m.feedback::text AS feedback, m.billed_tokens, s.is_test, l.name AS lab, c.name AS class
  FROM agent_runs r
  JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
  LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id = r.assistant_message_id
  LEFT JOIN labs l ON l.id = s.lab_id
  LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.id = l.class_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND (NOT s.is_test OR ${tests})
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Questions" FROM runs

panels.description: Half of the questions in each mode were answered faster than this.

panels.title: Refused before starting
panels.description: Questions the chat refused before they started: a limit reached, a locked lab, or a student no longer in the class.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Refused" FROM chat_refusals WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Students at a limit now
panels.description: Students who cannot start a question now (day or week limit). Days start at midnight Paris time, weeks on Monday.

targets.rawSql:
WITH day AS (
  SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS d,
         date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS w
), used AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, sum(s.tokens_used) FILTER (WHERE s.date = day.d) AS today, sum(s.tokens_used) AS week
  FROM usage_stats s CROSS JOIN day WHERE s.date >= day.w AND s.date <= day.d GROUP BY s.user_id
), granted AS (
  SELECT g.user_id, sum(g.tokens) FILTER (WHERE g.kind = 'day' AND g.date = day.d) AS today,
         sum(g.tokens) FILTER (WHERE g.kind = 'week') AS week
  FROM quota_grants g CROSS JOIN day WHERE g.date >= day.w AND g.date <= day.d GROUP BY g.user_id
), q AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id, coalesce(used.today, 0) AS used_today, coalesce(used.week, 0) AS used_week,
         u.daily_token_quota + coalesce(granted.today, 0) AS limit_today,
         u.weekly_token_quota + coalesce(granted.week, 0) AS limit_week
  FROM users u JOIN used ON used.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN granted ON granted.user_id = u.id
  WHERE u.role = 'student'
)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE used_today >= limit_today OR used_week >= limit_week) AS "Students" FROM q

panels.title: Reset requests today
panels.description: Students at a limit who asked their teacher for a reset today: still open, and all of today.

targets.rawSql:
WITH day AS (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS d)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.resolved_at IS NULL) AS "Open", count(*) AS "Asked"
FROM quota_reset_requests r CROSS JOIN day WHERE r.date = day.d

panels.title: Resets this week
panels.description: Times a teacher or an admin gave a student a full day and week again (since Monday). Usage is kept.

targets.rawSql:
WITH day AS (SELECT date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS w)
SELECT count(DISTINCT (g.user_id, g.created_at)) AS "Resets" FROM quota_grants g CROSS JOIN day WHERE g.date >= day.w

panels.title: Refused questions by reason
panels.description: In the time range. A limit refusal means the student saw the limit message.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE reason WHEN 'day_quota' THEN 'Day limit' WHEN 'week_quota' THEN 'Week limit'
                   WHEN 'lab_locked' THEN 'Lab locked' WHEN 'not_member' THEN 'Not in the class'
                   ELSE reason END AS "Reason",
       count(*) AS "Questions", count(DISTINCT user_id) AS "Students", max(created_at) AS "Last"
FROM chat_refusals WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Token use by class
panels.description: Students who used tokens this week, by class (a student counts in each of their classes). "Highest" is the student closest to the limit. No names: see the teacher Analytics tab.

targets.rawSql:
WITH day AS (
  SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS d,
         date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date AS w
), used AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, sum(s.tokens_used) FILTER (WHERE s.date = day.d) AS today, sum(s.tokens_used) AS week
  FROM usage_stats s CROSS JOIN day WHERE s.date >= day.w AND s.date <= day.d GROUP BY s.user_id
), granted AS (
  SELECT g.user_id, sum(g.tokens) FILTER (WHERE g.kind = 'day' AND g.date = day.d) AS today,
         sum(g.tokens) FILTER (WHERE g.kind = 'week') AS week
  FROM quota_grants g CROSS JOIN day WHERE g.date >= day.w AND g.date <= day.d GROUP BY g.user_id
), q AS (
  SELECT u.id AS user_id, coalesce(used.today, 0) AS used_today, coalesce(used.week, 0) AS used_week,
         u.daily_token_quota + coalesce(granted.today, 0) AS limit_today,
         u.weekly_token_quota + coalesce(granted.week, 0) AS limit_week
  FROM users u JOIN used ON used.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN granted ON granted.user_id = u.id
  WHERE u.role = 'student'
)
SELECT c.name AS "Class", count(*) AS "Students",
       sum(q.used_today) AS "Today", max(q.used_today::float / nullif(q.limit_today, 0)) AS "Highest today",
       sum(q.used_week) AS "This week", max(q.used_week::float / nullif(q.limit_week, 0)) AS "Highest this week",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.used_today >= q.limit_today OR q.used_week >= q.limit_week) AS "At a limit"
FROM q JOIN class_students cs ON cs.student_id = q.user_id JOIN classes c ON c.id = cs.class_id
WHERE NOT c.is_deleted GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 5 DESC

panels.title: Latest questions
panels.description: The 200 most recent questions in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT r.started_at, r.status, r.stop_reason, r.question,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS seconds,
         coalesce(r.mode, m.answer_mode,
                  CASE WHEN r.assistant_message_id IS NULL THEN 'unknown' ELSE 'research' END) AS mode,
         m.feedback::text AS feedback, m.billed_tokens, s.is_test, l.name AS lab, c.name AS class
  FROM agent_runs r
  JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
  LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.id = r.assistant_message_id
  LEFT JOIN labs l ON l.id = s.lab_id
  LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.id = l.class_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND (NOT s.is_test OR ${tests})
)
SELECT started_at AS "Time", class AS "Class", lab AS "Lab", mode AS "Mode",
       question AS "Question", seconds AS "Seconds", coalesce(stop_reason, status) AS "Stopped",
       feedback AS "Feedback", billed_tokens AS "Tokens", CASE WHEN is_test THEN 'teacher' ELSE '' END AS "Test"
FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Every model call made for the questions above, by purpose.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT u.purpose AS "Purpose", u.model AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.elapsed_seconds) AS "Median",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY u.elapsed_seconds) AS "95%",
       sum(u.input_tokens) AS "Input tokens", sum(u.output_tokens) AS "Output tokens",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.status <> 'ok') AS "Errors"
FROM model_call_usage u
JOIN agent_runs r ON r.id = u.run_id
JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at) AND (NOT s.is_test OR ${tests})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Document jobs
panels.description: Jobs updated in the time range, and every job still waiting, running or failed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT j.updated_at AS "Updated", d.filename AS "File", coalesce(j.task_kind, 'old') AS "Step",
       j.status::text AS "Status", j.attempts AS "Attempts", j.error_message AS "Error"
FROM ingestion_jobs j JOIN documents d ON d.id = j.document_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(j.updated_at) OR j.status::text IN ('queued', 'processing', 'failed')
ORDER BY (j.status::text = 'failed') DESC, j.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Reading time per page
panels.description: MinerU: median seconds per PDF page, in the time range (the whole PDF read, divided by its pages).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.parse_finished_at - r.parse_started_at)) / d.page_count) AS "Per page"
FROM document_revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id = r.document_id
WHERE r.parse_finished_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.parse_finished_at) AND d.page_count > 0

panels.title: Reading PDFs
panels.description: Each PDF read in the time range: wait before reading, reading time, time per page, and the time from the upload until students can use it (indexing done).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.parse_finished_at AS "Read at", d.filename AS "File", d.page_count AS "Pages",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.parse_started_at - r.created_at)) AS "Waited",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.parse_finished_at - r.parse_started_at)) AS "Reading",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.parse_finished_at - r.parse_started_at)) / nullif(d.page_count, 0) AS "Per page",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (j.updated_at - r.created_at)) AS "Until ready"
FROM document_revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id = r.document_id
LEFT JOIN ingestion_jobs j ON j.revision_id = r.id AND j.task_kind = 'pdf_index' AND j.status::text = 'done'
WHERE r.parse_finished_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.parse_finished_at)
ORDER BY r.parse_finished_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Wait before reading
panels.description: Median time from the upload to the start of the reading. PDFs are read one after another.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.parse_started_at - r.created_at))) AS "Wait"
FROM document_revisions r JOIN documents d ON d.id = r.document_id
WHERE r.parse_finished_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(r.parse_finished_at)
